summary: End-to-end verified hybrid auth + change-password feature. 11/11 pytest backend tests pass, and full Playwright UI flow passes (redirect, profile render, conditional current-password input, inline validation, successful set, reload-then-change, wrong-current server error surfaces on field + toast). Session-rotation-across-devices explicitly verified: two sessions seeded for same user; after change-password via session A, session A still authorized on /auth/me, session B returns 401.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /auth/logout does not gate on auth — anonymous call returns {ok:true}. Low risk (idempotent delete_many) but consider returning 401 when no token to keep semantics tight.
api.js changePassword forces current_password:null in body even for first-time set — backend tolerates it via `or ''` but sending undefined/omitting would be cleaner.
Settings.jsx: server errors that don't contain 'current password' or 'new password' only surface via toast (fine), but no aria-live region on FieldError; consider role='alert' for a11y.

Cookie set with SameSite=None + Secure is correct for cross-site; ensure CORS_ORIGINS is tightened from '*' in production (currently '*' with allow_credentials=True, which browsers reject for real cookies — works here because REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is same host as backend proxied).
test_credentials: None required — sessions seeded directly in Mongo per /app/auth_testing.md.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests use per-test fixture that seeds a users + user_sessions row and cleans up. UI test seeded one UI-user + UI_session, cleaned up after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base = REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL + '/api'. Mongo local (mongodb://localhost:27017, DB test_database). Tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — safe to rerun; fixtures self-clean. For UI, seed via mongo, then page.context.add_cookies({name:'session_token', domain: host of REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, httpOnly:True, secure:True, sameSite:'None'}). All expected test-ids present and functional.
